title: Dharmendra Birthday: Hema Malini & Family Celebration Pics
text:
Bollywood Icon Dharmendra Dies at 89,Leaving Behind a Legacy of Six Decades A titan of Indian cinema, Dharmendra ,affectionately known as the “He-Man of Bollywood,” has died at the age of 89,just fifteen days shy of his 90th birthday,according to the Press Trust of India (PTI). The actor, who remained active in the industry even in his later years, passed away following a brief period of hospitalization and close medical monitoring.
A Life Celebrated On and Off Screen Dharmendra was briefly admitted to Breach Candy Hospital in Mumbai earlier this month, but was discharged with instructions for continued observation. His death marks the end of an era and leaves a void in the hearts of millions of fans. In the wake of the news, heartfelt tributes and cherished memories are circulating online, including glimpses into his recent birthday celebrations.
On December 8, 2024, actress Hema Malini shared touching images and a heartfelt message commemorating Dharmendra’s birthday. She described him as “the man of her dreams,” reflecting on their enduring connection. “I have held his heart just as he has held mine ever since we first met years ago,” she wrote, expressing gratitude for their unwavering love and hoping for continued happiness and good health.
View this post on Instagram
Further images from 2023, originally shared on X (formerly Twitter), have resurfaced, showcasing a tender moment between Hema Malini and Dharmendra, with Malini kissing him on the cheek, surrounded by their daughters, Ahana and Esha.
Did you know? – Dharmendra debuted in 1960 with the film dil Bhi Tera Ham Bhi Tere . He initially faced rejection due to his non-filmi background, but persevered to become a leading man. A Career spanning Generations Throughout a career exceeding six decades, Dharmendra captivated audiences with his versatility and charisma. He notably shared the screen with his sons in the 2007 film Apne , and continued to take on roles in popular movies such as Yamla Pagla Deewana and Rocky Aur Rani Kii Prem Kahaani .
His performance in Rocky Aur Rani Kii Prem Kahaani , particularly a celebrated romantic scene with Shabana Azmi at the age of 86, garnered widespread acclaim and demonstrated his enduring appeal.
Pro tip: – Dharmendra was known for his intense method acting, often immersing himself deeply in his roles. He frequently performed his own stunts early in his career. A Final Performance Just yesterday, November 24, the poster for Dharmendra’s final film was unveiled. The war drama, starring Agastya Nanda , is based on the life of Arun Khetarpal and is scheduled for release on December 25, 2025. In the film, Dharmendra portrays M.L. Khetarpal, the hero’s father, offering a poignant final contribution to Indian cinema.

Who was Dharmendra? Dharmendra was a highly celebrated Indian actor, known as the “He-Man of Bollywood.” He starred in over 300 films over a career spanning six decades, and was known for his versatility, charisma, and iconic roles. He was also known for his close relationship with actress Hema Malini.
